sources.title: Empero — Independent AI Research Lab
sources.snippet: Empero is an independent AI research lab in Germany building small, efficient language models you can own and run yourself. Latest: Qwen3.8 distilled to 9B / 4B / 2B, and a GDN-aware 27B Ridge GGUF at 11.7 GiB. 1M+ downloads on Hugging Face.

sources.title: GitHub - 47thtechcorner/RayCodes_Qwen3.8Distilled: Qwen 3.8 2B, 4B & 9B ...
sources.snippet: The Teacher Model (Qwen3.8-2.4T): A massive AI running on multi-million dollar data centers. It generates step-by-step reasoning solutions ("Chain of Thought"). The Student Models (9B / 4B / 2B): Smaller models trained directly on the teacher's exact reasoning traces.
